panel.summary: Silent shortcut omits upstream `list`'s 4-space indented-code guard
panel.evidence: `wrappedList` returns true whenever `silent && parentType === 'paragraph' && isEmptyBulletLine(...)`, but `isEmptyBulletLine` only checks `state.sCount[line] >= state.blkIndent` (line 32) — it never rejects `state.sCount[line] - state.blkIndent >= 4`, which upstream `list` treats as an indented code block. Today this is masked because both `paragraph` and the forked `lheading` `continue` past lines indented >3 before consulting terminator rules, so the branch is unreachable; but any other rule that probes `list` silently while `parentType === 'paragraph'` would get a spurious paragraph termination for an indented-code line. Worth mirroring upstream's indent check for safety.
